description: Fetches the state of one of your separations by id (GET /stem-tool/jobs/{id}): state (uploading, queued, running, saving, done, failed, cancelled, expired), queue position, processed seconds against duration, time estimates, and, once done, the names of the stems available. A job unknown or belonging to another account answers the same 404. Costs no quota (read rate limit, 240 per minute): poll no faster than every few seconds.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_stems_separate (a UUID).

name: jj_stems_get_job
title: Get a stem separation status
